meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文本生成无脸解释视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作解释视频且无需真人出镜
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create explainer videos without footage or faces

howto.what: 装上此技能后，当你提供一篇文章、笔记或话题，Claude 会将其转化为一个无脸解释视频。它会自动设计每帧的视觉（文字、图形、图表），生成脚本、音频和动画帧，最终输出视频。
howto.when: 当你向 Claude 提交任意文本（如文章、笔记、话题），并要求制作解释视频时，它会触发这套工作流程。如果需求不明确，它会引导你到 /hyperframes 确认意图。

say.text: 请把这篇文章变成无脸解释视频。
say.note: Claude 会开始规划视频并执行后续步骤。

say.text: 为我制作一个关于光合作用的解释视频。
say.note: 它会基于你的要求生成脚本和视觉。

say.text: 将这段教程变成列表式解释视频。
say.note: 视频风格取决于你的描述。

howto.what_en: When you give Claude a text (article, notes, topic), it turns it into a faceless explainer video. It designs each frame's visuals (typography, diagrams, data-vis), generates script, audio, and animation frames, and outputs the final video. No website or footage needed.
howto.when_en: When you submit any text (article, notes, topic) and ask for an explainer video, this workflow triggers. If the request is unclear, it guides you to /hyperframes to confirm intent.

say_en.text: Turn this article into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude starts planning the video and executing steps.

say_en.text: Make an explainer video about photosynthesis.
say_en.note: It generates script and visuals based on your request.

say_en.text: Turn this tutorial into a listicle explainer.
say_en.note: Video style depends on your description.
